pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark contiguous regions exhibit sub-polygonal to rounded geometries with soft, anti-aliased pixel transitions at the edges. Patch size increases progressively from the neck towards the mid-flank area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned inter-patch spaces form a continuous topological network with distinct triple and quadruple junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors remains relatively consistent across the lateral view.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck displays a uniform, high-frequency serration of low amplitude against the out-of-focus background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism, likely an oxpecker (Buphagus sp.), perched on the upper-left dorsal neck region.
